fuse_bn_into_conv: fuse a BatchNorm layer into a Conv layer by absorbing its parameters into the convolution weights
fuse_resnet_batch_norm: fuse all BatchNorm layers into their corresponding Conv layers across a ResNet model
patch_resnet_bottleneck_forward: replace the ResNet Bottleneck forward method with a version that skips BatchNorm after fusion
patch_resnet_forward: replace the full ResNet forward method with a version that skips BatchNorm after fusion
review_fuse_bn: review the fuse_bn function to understand how it destructively merges BatchNorm stats into Conv weights
